Taxi App.about: taxi app: backend, driver app, operator web

Code Explainer.about: animated code explainer: shows code like a programmer navigating the IDE (name not decided; planning)

Hikvision.about: run Sanjar's own code on his own Hikvision CCTV cameras (e.g. camera -> Telegram, no NVR); research stage

Soft Skills.about: Sanjar's 12-week soft-skills coaching program; Jarvis coaches live on calls, a worker logs each session to memory/

QarsDaftar.about: debt-ledger app for sellers who sell on credit: track debts, SMS reminders, agreed late penalty, tamper-evident evidence for authorities (planning)

Game.about: a polished browser game with good animation and game feel (not started)

Gas Finder.about: Telegram bot that finds where gas is sold during supply cuts, crowdsourced from drivers' Telegram groups (text, voice, video; Uzbek/Russian, misspelled place names) (planning)

AI English Teacher.about: AI agent that teaches Uzbek speakers to speak English over Telegram (calls, lessons); planning, SRS/SDD done. Tickets are GitHub Issues on GitHub Project #4 (ref aet-<issue number>), Notion only mirrors them

Jarvis App.about: light Android app (APK, old phone) to talk to Jarvis: projects, chats per project, voice messages, live calls; talks to jarvis/core/appserver.py on the home Wi-Fi (0.1 built)

Code Learning.about: website that teaches students programming: Codewalk animation videos explain the content, then students try the tasks by writing the code themselves. Working name. Idea stage: Sanjar is discussing the SRS first, so nothing is planned or built yet

Apartment Search.about: worker that looks for a home in Samarkand for 5 people around $250 for Sanjar: every 30 min it reads public rental groups with the +7 906 job account, takes only places that accept boys and fit 5 young men by rooms, size and beds, writes to posters (5 new people a day, three fixed messages; it never tells them how many we are) and reports offers and owners' answers with photos to his Jarvis app chat. Change the price, people or limits in side_project/projects/apartment_search/config.json; when he says to stop or he found a place, set "active": false there

Creating Slides.about: Google Slides presentations made for Sanjar (for example a Present Simple English lesson deck). New decks: the google_slides tool (picture-heavy, through the Claude Google Drive connector, his sanjarsaidov173@gmail.com Drive). Material for decks lives in this folder, one subfolder per deck

Instagram Channels.about: Two new Instagram channels Jarvis runs for Sanjar to test views: an English-for-Uzbek-speakers channel (Uzbek voice, one rule or mistake per reel) and a Code Learning channel (short Rust lessons in English, link to learn.sanjarbek17.uz). Reels reuse the Haydovchi darslari studio (tts.py --dir, REEL_DIR render); accounts, bios and avatars are in channels.json and brand/, passwords only in its .env; accounts/signup.mjs signs an account up in a hidden Chrome

Yugur.about: Yugur: Flutter + Supabase running game for Samarkand/Uzbekistan where runners own H3 hex tiles by running (capture, loops, steal, strength, decay, anti-cheat, solo leaderboard; teams in v2). UI in Uzbek and Russian. SRS/SDD in docs/, build tickets on its own board; Sanjar asked not to be asked or made to test anything until version 1 is finished: Jarvis answers workers' questions itself.
